as_told.title: Chris Sharp's Liberation Times article naming Glenn Gaffney as a gatekeeper

plain: A podcast host, Jesse Michels, points to an article by the reporter Christopher Sharp in Liberation Times, an online news outlet, describing what Michels calls the network of secret long-running UFO programs, involving the US Department of Energy and the CIA's work on stopping the spread of weapons. Michels says the article lays out the chain of command for this UFO effort and names Glenn Gaffney, the CIA's director of science and technology, as a key figure, which would mean the programme reaches into senior intelligence posts.
